description:
Kim Do-hyun went to visit his girlfriend, Yoo Mi-hyun, at her house. There, he met Han Hee-kyung, Mi-hyun’s mother, who was a stunning beauty. However, Han Hee-kyung began treating Do-hyun not as her daughter’s boyfriend, but simply as a man...
